hello.title: HELLO WORLD
hello.currentDateTime: Current date and time, as computed by Python:
hello.description: PyScript allows you to run Python code directly in your web browser without any server-side processing. These examples demonstrate Python's capabilities, from basic "Hello World" output to date handling, Fibonacci sequences, and matrix traversals—all running entirely in your browser.

keyFeatures.consoleOutputDesc: View results in the browser console or write to the DOM
